demand_signal.notes: Launch multiplayer detainment walkthrough. SERP competitor Whisper of the House already covers sequence prose without timestamped dual-source frames or why-can't-I-arrest triage.

intent_brief.player_task: Complete the multiplayer Arrest/Detain sequence against Michael Myers, understand why knockdowns fail before readiness, and know that Michael cannot simply be killed.
required_answers: How police / reinforcements / Loomis-or-deputy involvement unlock detainment
Step-by-step arrest sequence with visual state markers
Why knockdowns fail before arrest readiness (diagnostic)
What the handcuff / Detain prompt looks like
intent_brief.stakes: Players waste full matches dumping damage into Michael without Loomis/deputy readiness; false kill advice conflicts with official design.
out_of_scope: Exact numeric arrest-meter fill rates or cooldowns
Story-mode detainment as Michael (single-player is played as Michael)

rationale: Community is supporting for landmarks/meta that remain unverified

unique_contribution: Three independent gameplay videos for arrest pressure / detain UI (Bryce Games guide + D3AD Plays live + Delirious collab POLICE WAGON CALLED)
Visual arrest-state progression: police wagon / cop arrival / reinforcements → handcuff readiness → [E] Detain → minigame → MICHAEL DETAINED
Why can't I arrest Michael diagnostic table tied to observed failed-knockdown states
Native 1080p player captures with facecam cropped; annotated Detain prompt
Public visual-quality gate passed for core Arrest UI readability
competitor_gap_summary: Whisper of the House has a prose arrest guide; reviews mention police wagon escapes and failed arrest attempts; Steam store confirms unkillable enemy. No competing page pairs two independent timestamped gameplay sources with handcuff→Detain→MICHAEL DETAINED frames plus a Why-can't-I-arrest diagnostic table.

claim_ledger.claim: Michael Myers cannot simply be killed in multiplayer; with enough community resistance he can be detained and returned to Smith's Grove Sanitarium.

Police presence escalates through Civilian calls and reinforcement progression; HUD can show messages such as POLICE WAGON CALLED, A COP HAS ARRIVED TO INVESTIGATE, and Reinforcements Available / Reinforcements In.
Dead or escaped Civilians can still support the match and return as a Sheriff's Deputy or Dr. Loomis; spectator-side Police Reinforcements perk can respawn a player as a police officer.
claim_ledger.applicability: Official multiplayer overview + Early Access spectator perk UI

claim_ledger.claim: When arrest readiness is building, Michael shows a handcuff-style indicator (diamond/icon with handcuffs) on or near him.
Knocking Michael down before arrest readiness is complete is not enough—he can recover; the useful knockdown comes after handcuff readiness / police pressure is established.
After a valid knockdown in the ready state, the interaction prompt [E] Detain Michael appears with a handcuff icon.
Completing Detain Michael requires finishing a short circular progress / input interaction before Michael recovers.
claim_ledger.applicability: Multiplayer Early Access footage Sep 2026; corroborated by ArrisWuju commentary

claim_ledger.claim: A successful Detain ends the match with MICHAEL DETAINED! (GAME OVER / You Survived The Night); remaining Civilians do not need a separate escape afterward.
